intent: When a subscription's Tier is PRO, each add-on's MonthlyFee must be provided (it must not be left empty).
notes: Exercises the iteration/negative-guard idiom: a bare FieldNotFilled in the repeatable Addons scope trips MVK_NEG_CONDITION_IN_ITERATION unless guarded by a positive GroupFilled. Tier is referenced by absolute path (cross-group); MonthlyFee is bare (in the iteration scope).
